Student of the Year: After Dark की डायरेक्टर रीमा माया ने अपने एक इंटरव्यू में बड़ा खुलासा किया है।

इंटरव्यू के दौरान डायरेक्टर ने बताया कि शनाया कपूर ने इस प्रोजेक्ट के लिए बहुत कड़ी मेहनत की है।

रीमा माया के मुताबिक शनाया कपूर अपने काम के लिए पूरी तरह तैयार थीं और काफी तैयारी के साथ काम पर आती थीं।

डायरेक्टर ने शनाया के काम और उनकी लगन की जमकर तारीफ की है।

क्या आप शनाया कपूर को इस नए प्रोजेक्ट में देखने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? अपनी राय कमेंट्स में जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Student of the Year: After Dark director Reema Maaya Interview: Shanaya Kapoor worked really hard and was very prepared
ctx.summary:
In an exclusive conversation with Pinkvilla, director Reema Maya opens up about reimagining the familiar Student of the Year universe with Student of the Year 3: After Dark ( starring Shanaya Kapoor (in a double role), Divik Sharma, Manya Grover, and Mannat Duggal), taking the franchise into a darker, more intense space. She discusses working with Shanaya Kapoor on her dual characters, exploring the pressures of competition and validation among today's youth, and the creative process behind the thriller.  
 Excerpts from the interview  
 1. Title Student of the Year has always been associated with glamour, romance, friendship and campus rivalries. What was your thought and approach to taking this universe into the darker territory of a thriller? 
 R:  Student of the Year: After Dark is a young adult border-mystery competition series, and the Student of the Year franchise reimagined for today's generation. It is an angsty, gritty young adult project that speaks to the hyper-competitive mindset our youth face and how it affects their friendships, their interpersonal relationships, and their sense of self. It is fairly dark, and it is an imperfect world full of imperfect people and each and every one of us is fighting so many conflicts outside and within ourselves. So, that was the world that we chose to set this franchise in.
